title: Mary's Song of Praise (Magnificat)
description: Mary visits Elizabeth in the hill country of Judea. The baby leaps in Elizabeth's womb, and she blesses Mary. Mary joins in with the song of praise known as the Magnificat: 'My soul magnifies the Lord.' She stays with Elizabeth for about three months.
